svg.text: Rack units are counted from the base (U1). Floor 2 racks and the floor 1 server space are drawn as standard 42U frames; usable height is confirmed on site before positions are fixed.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Patching: four 24-port panels terminate the 96 existing floor 1 Cat 5e runs and five 24-port panels terminate the 120 existing floor 2 Cat 6 runs; spare space takes panels for up to 60 extra runs.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Internet path: the nbn NTD hands off to FW-HQ, which sits in front of CORE 1 and CORE 2 (ISP, then firewall, then core stack). FW-BR does the same job at Cairns. Shelf items are desktop units.
